name: Ghibli Park (overseas tickets)
intro: A Studio Ghibli park near Nagoya with full-size buildings and scenes from the films, spread across five areas. It is not a ride park. Tickets are sold online only for a set date, and a whole month goes on sale at once.

facts.price: Standard pass ¥3,300 to ¥3,800 for adults; Premium pass ¥7,300 to ¥7,800 (weekdays to weekends)
facts.bookAhead: Two months: tickets go on sale on the 10th, two months before

statusNote: Read from the official overseas ticket page.
popularityNote: Keyword data (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026): "ghibli park tickets" and "ghibli park ticket" about 50,000 searches a month each; fewer high-volume searches than the Ghibli Museum.
difficultyNote: Estimate: weekend and holiday Premium passes go first after the release; weekday Standard passes often stay on sale longer.
bookingSteps: Check the Park Calendar and choose a pass: Premium covers all five areas, Standard covers three.
Buy from one of the two official overseas sellers linked from the official ticket page: Lawson Ticket or Klook.
Book in the name of someone who is visiting. Buying on someone else's behalf is not allowed.
At 14:00 Japan time on the 10th, choose a date and an entry time for Ghibli's Grand Warehouse. Each ticket type can be bought once a month, up to six tickets.
You receive one electronic ticket with a QR code for the whole group. It can't be split between people.
On the day, bring the named ticket holder’s passport. The whole group enters the first area together with that person.
Enter Ghibli's Grand Warehouse within one hour of your entry time. Early entry isn't allowed.
visitorTips: No refunds or changes to the date, time, ticket type or number of tickets after booking.
Resale, transfer and gifting are banned. Tickets that seem to come from auctions are refused, and ID may be checked at random.
Children aged 3 and under enter free and aren't counted in the group. Some play areas are only for children 12 and under.
Phone help in English and other languages: +81 50 3626 2455 (international calls). Tickets can't be bought by phone.

faq.q: When do Ghibli Park tickets go on sale for overseas visitors?
faq.a: On the 10th of each month at 14:00 Japan time, for visits two months later. For example, December tickets go on sale on October 10.

faq.q: Can I buy Ghibli Park tickets at the park?
faq.a: No. Tickets are sold online only.

sources.quote: Reservations for December 2026 go on sale October 10th 2026 at 2 p.m. (Japan time).
